records.title: Cloud homes can report when they are idle and get ready to sleep
records.changeSummary: Idle reporting and coordinated sleep span server routes, routines and client lifecycle.
records.reason: Review as a separate Origin computer-lifecycle project; the upstream Cloud-home ownership and billing policies do not map directly to Origin workspaces.
records.requiredAcceptance: Fake lifecycle tests for all members, outstanding runs, routines, reconnect and sleep/wake transitions.

records.title: Desktop and broker: leave a sleeping Cloud home asleep, and wake it when needed
records.changeSummary: Sleep/wake changes cross the Electron sync clients and Composio broker migrations.
records.reason: Keep broker and subscription policy out of the current shared-chat delivery; a client-only port would omit the wake contract.
records.requiredAcceptance: Origin-owned broker authentication, durable wake requests and offline/reconnect qualification before any port.

records.title: Team map: show each bot's computer with a live screen
records.changeSummary: Team-map computer nodes add live frame sources and composer integration.
records.reason: Potential team visibility feature, but requires Origin project visibility and frame permissions rather than copying the upstream map.
records.requiredAcceptance: Project membership, frame access revocation, denied viewers, narrow layout and inactive computer states.

records.title: test: fix main (Live call journeys and Grok import route tests)
records.changeSummary: Only Live call journey and Grok import route tests change.
records.reason: No product code to import in this release; revisit test expectations with the corresponding upstream feature contracts.
records.requiredAcceptance: Compare prerequisites before reusing the fixtures; do not change Origin behavior to satisfy unrelated upstream tests.

records.title: fix(server): a data lane's early abort no longer strands the statement
records.changeSummary: The data engine and its test cover aborting an early statement lane.
records.reason: Promising focused reliability follow-up; changed-file triage does not prove Origin reproduces the abort defect.
records.requiredAcceptance: Synthetic early abort, statement cleanup, subsequent query success and cancellation without partial side effects.

records.title: feat(chat): preview HTML file attachments in a sandboxed frame
records.changeSummary: Adds a sandboxed HTML attachment preview with a 2 MiB read cap, source toggle and download.
records.reason: Origin has table preview support but no HtmlFilePreview component in either comparison snapshot. Adapt to shared attachment authorization and Origin dialogs.
records.requiredAcceptance: Blocked scripts, navigation and external requests; bounded/aborted reads, shared-message access, focus return and mobile light/dark captures.

records.title: feat(templates): a gallery of ready-made bots
records.changeSummary: Adds a ready-made bot gallery and reusable templates.
records.reason: The gallery and ready-bots catalog are absent in both snapshots. Adapt templates to project Chiefs and their agents instead of creating a parallel hierarchy.
records.requiredAcceptance: Role mapping, exact project placement, review-before-create, model availability and no accidental extra project bosses.

records.title: chore(release): bump version to 0.1.117
records.changeSummary: The only changed file is package.json for upstream 0.1.117.
records.reason: Keep Origin versioning, shared changelog, artifacts and update feeds; do not import an upstream release number.
records.requiredAcceptance: Origin release process owns the next version and matching manifests.

records.title: Make an OpenRouter key work out of the box on OpenRouter's free tier
records.changeSummary: Adds free-tier detection, free tool-capable OpenRouter defaults and bounded provider-specific failure messages.
records.reason: Neither snapshot has openrouter-free.ts. Current OpenAI-compatible catalog selection has no equivalent free-tier-aware default; adapt without replacing an explicit model or spending consent.
records.requiredAcceptance: Mock free/paid/unknown tier and catalog responses, first-turn timeout, explicit selection preservation, API budget and safe error mapping.

records.title: Routines: Mark all as seen covers only the runs the person can see
records.changeSummary: Routines mark-as-seen changes include a bot visibility test and the server route.
records.reason: Prioritize a focused access comparison next; filenames indicate the right boundary, but no current Origin access bug is claimed from triage alone.
records.requiredAcceptance: Two synthetic members with visible and hidden bot runs; mark-all may update only rows the caller can see.

records.title: Cloud home image ships python3, pdftotext and unzip
records.changeSummary: The Cloud image adds Python, PDF text extraction and unzip utilities.
records.reason: Potential self-hosted image improvement, separate from desktop packaging and not a reason to import upstream image publishing.
records.requiredAcceptance: Reproducible image build, tool smoke checks, licenses and Origin image size/security impact.

records.title: Servers built into an image report their version
records.changeSummary: Bundle-server, packaged smoke and environment files propagate a server image version.
records.reason: Compare Origin bundle version injection before adopting; changed paths alone do not show an Origin version-reporting defect.
records.requiredAcceptance: Build an Origin image/server bundle and assert the reported Origin version matches its artifact identity.

records.title: Browser: a passkey request without an authenticator fails like real Chrome, so sign-in can pick another way
records.changeSummary: Passkey handling spans browser CDP/chrome identity and sign-in fixtures.
records.reason: Useful browser compatibility work only with its full browser lifecycle prerequisites; do not copy a sign-in workaround into unrelated Origin auth.
records.requiredAcceptance: Isolated virtual-authenticator behavior, alternate sign-in recovery and Origin browser ownership/access fences.

records.title: feat(cloud): one place for This computer and My Cloud, and Send everything to My Cloud
records.changeSummary: Unifies This computer/My Cloud and introduces a broad send-everything migration.
records.reason: Upstream Cloud subscription and login-transfer semantics do not fit wholesale. Origin deliberately removed those subscription surfaces and uses its own account/project synchronization.
records.requiredAcceptance: Separate migration design covering encrypted credentials, membership, per-machine folders, idempotency and explicit transfer choices.

records.title: Browser: tell sites the person's languages as Chrome does, and the owner's time zone
records.changeSummary: Browser identity setup passes language preferences and the owner time zone.
records.reason: Potential compatibility improvement, pending the Origin browser backend mapping and owner/requester identity rules.
records.requiredAcceptance: Synthetic locale/time-zone configuration across local and shared computers, without exposing another member profile.

records.title: Cloud homes wait for memory before starting another engine, and say when memory ran out
records.changeSummary: Memory admission and OOM diagnosis span registry, process tracking, watchdog and image configuration.
records.reason: Treat as a resource-management integration rather than copying an upstream Cloud memory limit into desktop sender-runs.
records.requiredAcceptance: Controlled memory pressure, cancellation, queue fairness, process cleanup and truthful OOM reporting.

records.title: Lending: a restarting My Cloud answers the desktop as restarting, and the lending e2e waits for its own turn
records.changeSummary: Restart status handling changes shared-computer code and the lending fixture.
records.reason: Defer with the upstream lending/restart lifecycle; it is not an independent Origin shared-model implementation.
records.requiredAcceptance: Origin computer ownership and reconnect behavior with a synthetic restarting host.

records.title: Release: give the macOS packaging step a 4 GB Node heap
records.changeSummary: The upstream release workflow gives macOS packaging a 4 GiB Node heap.
records.reason: Origin desktop CI already declares NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192. No upstream workflow or release-source substitution is needed for this setting.
records.requiredAcceptance: Continue Origin macOS artifact verification in its own workflow; no additional upstream patch was imported.

records.title: Server: find stale peer cards without loading every conversation at boot
records.changeSummary: Peer-approval boot recovery uses message-db and peer-approval changes.
records.reason: Promising bounded startup optimization; retain exact approval ownership and expiry semantics.
records.requiredAcceptance: Large synthetic conversation store, indexed stale-card selection, active cards untouched and no loss of approvals.

records.title: Idle browsers close even while a view is open
records.changeSummary: Idle browser cleanup changes service/runtime/viewers and renderer reconnect behavior.
records.reason: Review together with browser lifecycle dependencies; an open shared view must not silently change Origin permissions or close active work.
records.requiredAcceptance: Idle versus active use, multiple viewers, wake/reconnect, revoked access and streaming teardown.

records.title: Cloud homes close idle browsers after 3 minutes
records.changeSummary: Cloud-only browser cleanup introduces a three-minute idle policy.
records.reason: Do not apply an upstream Cloud timeout to every Origin computer. Coordinate with 3116 and 3118 as one lifecycle proposal.
records.requiredAcceptance: Choose Origin scope and timeout, then prove active turns and valid viewers survive while abandoned browsers close.

records.title: Close a deleted bot's browser on Cloud homes, and sweep strays
records.changeSummary: Bot deletion and stray browser cleanup touch the host browser lifecycle.
records.reason: Potential leak fix, but requires the actual Origin browser owner and deletion path comparison before adoption.
records.requiredAcceptance: Delete one synthetic bot while another is active; only the deleted bot browser closes, including interrupted startup.

records.title: test(limit-reset): the after-reset route uses the injected clock (fixes main)
records.changeSummary: The limit-reset route and its test use an injected clock.
records.reason: Useful deterministic testing pattern; do not infer an Origin quota/reset error without comparing the route contract.
records.requiredAcceptance: Clock-boundary regression using the existing Origin reset flow and no wall-clock timing assumptions.

records.title: OpenCode threads share one process on the same spawn contract
records.changeSummary: ACP/OpenCode can share a process when spawn contracts match.
records.reason: Potential memory saving, but shared-process keys must include Origin owner, project, credentials, cwd, tool grants and hosted confinement.
records.requiredAcceptance: Two owners/projects with distinct contracts must never share a process or context; verify cancellation and process lifetime.

records.title: Cloud homes keep idle engines only for the conversation a person has open
records.changeSummary: Idle engine lifetime is tied to visible conversation presence.
records.reason: Do not import a Cloud-only retention policy wholesale. Origin shared execution and background delegation may run without an open viewer.
records.requiredAcceptance: Requester/owner presence, hidden active delegated turns, reconnect and native-session recovery.

records.title: OpenCode reaches OpenMausBot's own MCP servers over HTTP, without a proxy process each
records.changeSummary: Own MCP servers can use loopback Streamable HTTP instead of one proxy process per server.
records.reason: The new own-mcp-http transport is absent in both snapshots. Any adoption must requalify Origin turn capabilities, hosted tool allowlists and private-owner isolation.
records.requiredAcceptance: Capability binding, loopback URL validation, per-turn identity, denied tools, cancellation, output bounds and no token leakage.

records.title: Headless Chrome runs no omnibox popup or reload button WebUI
records.changeSummary: Headless Chrome flags remove unused WebUI surfaces.
records.reason: Small potential resource optimization after the Origin Chrome backend and supported-version comparison.
records.requiredAcceptance: Browser startup, sign-in, navigation and frame streaming under the packaged Chrome version.

records.title: Server: read coordination state once per bot, not once per task
records.changeSummary: Coordination snapshots move from per-task to per-bot reads.
records.reason: Good profiling candidate, but cached snapshots must preserve Origin thread-specific visibility and active delegation updates.
records.requiredAcceptance: Measure read counts with many tasks; assert fresh per-thread state, cancellation and project permission changes.

records.title: Server: cap the stream replay buffer by size as well as count
records.changeSummary: Extracts replay buffering with both 500-frame and 8,000,000-character limits.
records.reason: Both Origin snapshots retain the 500-frame-only buffer. A focused adaptation fits, but the upstream character budget must not be described as a byte limit.
records.requiredAcceptance: Large full-bot frames, multibyte text, sequence gaps/resnapshot, client-specific redaction and screen-frame exclusion.

records.title: Server: read the Team map's last-message times without loading each room
records.changeSummary: Team-map last-message timestamps come from message-db instead of loading every room.
records.reason: Potential startup/map optimization; compare Origin project-room queries and visibility before adapting.
records.requiredAcceptance: Large synthetic room set, correct last-message ordering and no hidden-project metadata disclosure.

records.title: Server: keep inline base64 payloads out of the native protocol log
records.changeSummary: Native protocol logs replace inline image/document base64 payloads with bounded markers.
records.reason: Both snapshots redact secrets but retain this separate inline-payload path. A focused adaptation can reduce private artifact retention and log volume.
records.requiredAcceptance: Synthetic screenshot/document/data URL payloads absent on disk; preserve useful protocol fields and existing credential redaction.

records.title: Server: redact and serialize each runtime event once for its log line
records.changeSummary: Queued event logs retain one redacted serialized line instead of recomputing it for persistence.
records.reason: Both snapshots serialize/redact for queue sizing and again in appendGroup. Preserve live event objects and existing incomplete-log warnings.
records.requiredAcceptance: Redaction call/serialization counts, queue byte accounting, event order, terminal events and disk-failure diagnostics.

records.title: Server: diff a memory file's shared prefix without the line table
records.changeSummary: Memory-journal diff changes target shared-prefix allocation.
records.reason: Potential bounded memory optimization, pending comparison with Origin memory privacy and journal durability paths.
records.requiredAcceptance: Large synthetic memory files, exact diff reconstruction, Unicode/newline edges and unchanged journal attribution.

records.title: Server: let idle conversations leave the message cache
records.changeSummary: Adds idle transcript cache eviction with busy-thread preservation and reload from the message DB.
records.reason: Both snapshots still use Store.threads Map rather than ThreadCache. Adapt only after checking Origin shared, delegated and detached hosted tasks.
records.requiredAcceptance: Evict idle histories, reload exact branches/messages and preserve busy, queued, delegated and hosted conversation state.

records.title: Performance: Cloud memory, browsers and server (combined)
records.changeSummary: The performance rollup contains the same changed-path union as its sixteen scoped child PRs.
records.reason: Keep as an aggregate source identity; never count its child functionality twice or wholesale-merge it over Origin runtime work.
records.requiredAcceptance: Evaluate individual child changes and required dependencies; no independent adoption is counted.

records.title: chore(release): bump version to 0.1.118
records.changeSummary: The only changed file is package.json for upstream 0.1.118.
records.reason: Keep Origin versioning and publication manifests; an upstream release bump is not an Origin product change.
records.requiredAcceptance: Origin release process owns the next version and matching manifests.
